repo.name: vllm

detail.body:
- Engine / V1: widen `is_cuda()` gates to `is_cuda_alike()` and drop stale ROCm skips in the worker, sampler, KV connector/offload, EC connector, DP and spec-decode tests.
- Kernels: unskip attention, MoE, top-k, mamba, mHC, compressor-KV and quant tests; the fnuz-gated fp8 references now use `current_platform.fp8_dtype()`.
- Models and quantization: unskip the inkling, QSA reference, mistral3, mimo-v2 and model-init tests, plus params in `test_compressed_tensors.py`, `test_auto_round.py` and `test_fp8.py`.
- Where only some params fail on ROCm, the skip is narrowed to them with the real reason; the two Engram stream-overlap tests stay CUDA-only, since HIP can put both streams on one hardware queue.
- `test_gpu_rejection_sampler_chunking.py` compares replay logprobs to torch with `assert_close`, because Triton's and torch's `log` can differ by 1 ULP on ROCm.
- CI: wire the tests no AMD step ran into `test-amd.yaml` and its `test_areas/` mirrors, and run `test_gdn_aiter_flydsl.py` and `test_mla_backends.py` with `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1`.

Many tests were skipped on AMD with reasons that no longer hold, so regressions in those paths went unnoticed on ROCm. Everything unskipped here passes 10 times in a row on MI355, and there are no `vllm/` source changes: tests that still need a source fix stay skipped and are listed below. In the latest run ([build 96989](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/96989)), the only failures that are not flakes are in MI300 `V1 Attention`, and they are exactly the prerequisites below. This is not a duplicate: the only related open PR, #53925, adds multi-GPU groups to `test-amd.yaml` and changes no test skips.

**Merge after these** (all for MI300 `test_mla_backends.py` with AITER):
1. #62725 (draft): serves gfx942 MLA verify past 4 draft tokens; fixes the 16 `spec_decode_medium` failures (`cannot get heuristic kernel ... qseqlen:8`).
2. An AITER release that includes ROCm/aiter#6748 (merged, but not in `v0.1.26`), then bump `AITER_BRANCH` in `Dockerfile.rocm_base`; fixes the GLM chunked-context mismatch from CK FMHA bf16 truncation.
3. Not blocking: ROCm/aiter#6277 for ROCm/aiter#6731. The gfx942 persistent MLA decode is wrong in about 1 in 1000 calls, so `ROCM_AITER_MLA` can flake until it lands.

Follow-up: #65595 adds a ROCm path for the shared Engram host tables whose CUDA-only imports this PR guards in `test_engram_dp_shard.py`.

AI assistance (Claude Code) was used to draft this change. Every line was reviewed by the submitter.

- `models/kimi_k3/test_prefix_cache.py:54`: GPU memory access fault in the MXFP4 emulation MoE path.
- `models/language/pooling/test_token_classification.py:161`: workspace growth after lock (#48510).
- Flaky: `kernels/test_compressor_kv_cache.py:1055` (1 of 4 runs, aux-stream join after HIP graph replay), `v1/engine/test_async_llm.py:40` (`test_abort_final_output`, 3 of 5 runs).
- Needs a source fix: `jit_monitor/test_hooks.py:329`, `kernels/helion/*`, `kernels/moe/test_topk_softplus_sqrt.py:326`, `kernels/quantization/test_block_fp8.py:215`, `kernels/test_relu2_fp8_quant.py:19`, `model_executor/test_jit_warmup_triton_launcher.py:122`, `models/glm5next/test_kda_recurrent.py:197`, `v1/attention/test_indexer_dcp_localize.py:889`, `v1/determinism/test_matmul_batch_invariant.py:120`, `v1/engine/test_abort_final_step.py:40`, `kernels/moe/test_moe.py:358` + `test_batched_moe.py:390` (TD path), `models/qwen4_exp/test_hc_ops.py:18`.
- No ROCm caller (pass, but ROCm never runs the code under test): `test_kimi_k3_mla_key_concat_kv_cache.py`, `test_kimi_k3_mla_fused_epilogue.py`, `models/kimi_k3/test_attn_res.py`, `test_deepseek_v4_mega_moe.py`, `quantization/test_auto_round.py:729`, `test_minimax_m3.py:1386`, `test_minimax_m3_fp8_triton_indexer.py`, `kernels/moe/test_unquantized_backend_selection.py:306` (the tests mock `is_cuda=True`, `is_rocm=False`).

Also found along the way: `test_engine_core.py::test_engine_core_tp` is broken on every platform with 2 or more GPUs (`num_cpu_blocks` is never set since 65b2f405dc), and `test_mistral3.py::test_mm_device_do_normalize` fails on ROCm with main's file, so the AMD command selects only the patch-embed test from that file.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Source fixes still needed (not in this PR)</summary>

1. `amd/quant_utils.cuh` has no bf16/half `scaled_convert`, so the Kimi-K3 ds_mla fp8 insert truncates instead of encoding.
2. `layers/mhc.py:71` initializes HIP in the parent on import, which forces spawn.
3. `benchmarks/forward/capture.py` records external events inside HIP graph capture, so replay hangs.
4. glm5next AMD KDA grid z = N*HV overflows 65535 (the NVIDIA copy moved it to gridDim.x).
5. `router/dsv4_topk.py` gates a plain Triton kernel on `is_cuda()`. It passes on gfx950, but needs perf and lm_eval before enabling.
6. `fusion/fused_act_quant.py` registers the ReLU2 static-FP8 producer only for CUDA SM90+.
7. `jit_warmup_triton_helper.py` disables parallel Triton compile on ROCm; the AMD LLVM abort needs a root cause.
8. `utils/jit_monitor.py` disables the TileLang hook on ROCm (#51159).
9. compressed-tensors `transform/module.py` calls CUDA-only `hadacore_transform` with no ROCm fallback.
10. `inc_mxfp4_moe.py` falls back to Marlin on ROCm instead of the AITER MXFP4 backend.
11. qwen4_exp `amd/ops/hc.py` does not accept `injection_logits=None`.
12. deepseek_v41 `amd/vl_model.py:343` materializes the whole checkpoint instead of streaming it.
13. `vocab_parallel_embedding.py` enables the fused embedding only on CUDA, though the kernel passes on ROCm.
14. `kernels/triton/activation.py:103` marks the `gelu_and_mul_sparse` Triton provider as CUDA-only.
15. `csrc/topk.cu`: `persistent_topk` is a stub on ROCm.
16. `BlockWiseTorchFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel.is_supported` returns True on ROCm without 128x128 block scaling.
17. fp8_e5m2 KV is advertised by ROCM_ATTN/TRITON_ATTN but not dispatched.
18. Helion has no `amd_instinct_*` tuned configs.
19. batch-invariant persistent matmul has no gfx942/gfx950 buckets.
20. Torch symmetric memory is gated to CUDA, although ROCm torch exposes `_SymmetricMemory`.
21. deepseek_v41 aux-stream event joins leave intermittently stale compressor state after HIP graph replay.
22. qwen4_exp `amd/ops/hc.py` registers the same `vllm::qwen4_exp_*` op names as the NVIDIA module.
23. `moe_use_td_hw_supported` returns False on ROCm, but the TD paths pass 10/10 on gfx950.
24. `Fp8MoEMethod.process_weights_after_loading` normalizes to fnuz unconditionally, so reloading trips the e4m3fn assert.

</details>

On CUDA it only makes the prefetch stream higher priority than the default stream; the event record/wait ordering the test checks is unchanged, and the streams already overlapped there. PyTorch also maps out-of-range priorities to the nearest valid one, so -1 is fine on any device. It's needed on ROCm because HIP can put same-priority streams on one hardware queue and serialize them, so the test wouldn't actually exercise the overlap.
